activity: Explore one of Berlin's most iconic bookstores with a vast collection of books, including international titles, music, and cultural items. Great for browsing and picking up unique finds.
Visit this trendy independent bookstore known for its curated selection of contemporary literature, art books, and magazines. A cool spot to discover new reads and enjoy the creative vibe.
twist: Upon arrival, the traveler discovers that this place is not the claimed bookstore but another store called 'Voo Store' - a contemporary fashion store offering clothing, shoes, homeware, and accessories, with a café.
alternatives: Modern Graphics - A comicshop offering graphic novels, artbooks, Marvel, DC, independent publishers, toys, merchandise and much more.

activity: Enjoy authentic South American cuisine with a focus on Argentinian and other Latin American dishes in a lively atmosphere. Perfect for a flavorful lunch with friends.
twist: Upon arrival, the traveler discovers that this place is not the claimed restaurant 'Sudaka' but another resaurant called 'Kimchi Princess' - a Korean BBQ restaurant with red walls, wooden tables & bench seating, also serving dishes to share.
alternatives: Windburger - A popular, no-frills burger joint in Berlin known for its creative variety of handmade toppings, generous portions, and a laid-back atmosphere.
Miss Saigon - Vietnamese specialties & standards, plus many vegan options, in a casual, colorful venue.

activity: Spend the afternoon playing classic and modern arcade games, pinball machines, and enjoy drinks. A fun and interactive way to relax and have a great time with friends.
twist: Upon arrival, the traveler discovers that this place is not the claimed Arcade bar but a café called 'Five Elephant' - a coffee shop and bakery known for roasting its own beans and serving a very famous cheesecake.
alternatives: Dietrich Bar - A cocktail venue with cozy antique vibes.

activity: End the day with karaoke at one of Berlin's most popular karaoke bars. Sing your favorite songs in a lively, friendly environment and enjoy the nightlife vibe.
twist: Upon arrival, the traveler finds that this place is not the claimed karaoke bar but a residential building. They are scheduled to spend two hours here according to the itinerary.
alternatives: Basmah - an African snack bar that serves Sudanese sandwiches and platters.
Galerie Met (will close in 1h) - An art gallery with focus on contemporary art, and digital art in Metaverse.
